title: Nizam & Subsidiary Alliance: people, policies, annexations

boxes.title: People at Hyderabad
head: Person
Role
rows: 1766 mediator; used pay mutiny at **Gollapudi**; ==Majumdar of Rajamahendravaram==, "**Raja Bahadur**" (APPSC G2 2019)
**Mir Turab Ali Khan**, Diwan **31 May 1853** after **Siraj-ul-Mulk**; served 3 Nizams till **1883**
Sought to free **Chida Khan**; repulsed by **Davidson**

boxes.title: Nizams & Andhra: added detail
items: Ceded Districts = ==**Dattamandalalu**==; Nandyal Mahasabha president **Dr S. Radhakrishnan**
**1794**: ==**Battle of Padmanabham**==: Chinna Vijayaramaraju of Vizianagaram defeated
Circars today: Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, East + West Godavari, Krishna
Subsidiary aim also: a large army ==at the states' cost==

boxes.title: Paramountcy
items: States had ==no external life==; British intervened to give effect to their **international commitments** (APPSC-G2 2017)
After **1858** (subordinate union): annexation stopped, **adoption** recognised; princes = "**breakwaters to the storm**"

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: APPSC-G1 2024: of Awadh, Jhansi, Satara, Nagpur, Sindh → lapse = ==**Jhansi, Satara, Nagpur**==
⚠ **Jaitpur** (1849), not Jaipur; Udaipur = Chhattisgarh, not Mewar
